<html><head><title>x</title></head><body>hello</body></html>

for enc in ISO-2022-JP SHIFT-JIS EUC-JP UTF-16 ISO-8859-2 WINDOWS-1251 HTML ASCII; do echo ENC=$enc; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/libxml-build/xmllint --html --encode "$enc" --output /no/such/dir/out /tmp/test.html >/tmp/out 2>/tmp/err; rc=$?; echo rc=$rc; grep -E "ERROR: AddressSanitizer|heap-use|unknown encoding|failed" -m3 /tmp/err || cat /tmp/err | head -3; done'
